documents.name: retention.md
documents.text: Customer archives expire ninety days after closure. Archives under a legal hold must never be deleted until the hold is released.

documents.name: upload.md
documents.text: Upload defaults permit files up to ten mebibytes. An approved operator may upload a file up to twenty mebibytes; larger files are always rejected.

documents.name: guest.md
documents.text: Guest credentials expire twenty-four hours after issuance. A guest credential cannot be renewed; a new invitation is required.

documents.name: current-deployment.md
documents.text: Operators may deploy customer workloads on Friday under the current release standard.

documents.name: legacy-deployment.md
documents.text: Operators must not deploy customer workloads on Friday under the legacy release standard.

documents.name: editorial.md
documents.text: Editorial examples use clear wording and short sentences. This writing reference does not define archive retention or upload limits.

documents.name: calendar.md
documents.text: Equipment reservations run through the office calendar. This scheduling reference does not define customer permissions or guest credentials.

documents.name: notifications.md
documents.text: Notification defaults disable promotional messages. Transactional messages remain enabled unless the account is suspended.

scoring.historical_correct: Complete expected sentences; no-op requires no evidence; exact citations and token cap.
scoring.precise_correct: Historical correct plus no additional source basenames.
scoring.positive_exact: Positive tasks with precise_correct / all positive tasks; empty positive retrieval fails.
scoring.positive_source_precision: Expected source memberships / all retrieved source memberships on positive tasks; each source counted once per task. Raw counts, no 0/0 ratio.
scoring.acceptance: Per mode/strategy: all positive recall, positive exact, no-op, citation and token gates must pass; empty subsets are not accepted. CLI requires every row precise_correct.

limitations: Evaluation-only query interventions. Providers disabled. Fresh seeded SQLite/Lance stores per repeat/export mode; not ingestion, model extraction, semantic acceptance, native-host or adapter latency. Excerpts use reference chunks; rules-only uses manually supplied whole-document authoritative rules to isolate scope from extraction/grouping. Positive recall requires every expected sentence. Precision measures fixture source membership, not semantic relevance within an expected document. Case order reverses and strategy order rotates on fresh repeats.
